reason: $59 a month is a lot on $38k when library storytime and the parks are free. I only get Saturdays, so I would never get my money's worth from unlimited.
objection: I can only go on weekends, so a monthly membership makes no sense when storytime and parks cost nothing.
would_change_my_mind: A cheap weekend-only pass, or drop-in of about $6 with no required drink, that I could use a couple of Saturdays a month.
